params.token_: ERC-20 used by every pot (Arc USDC in production).

params.minContribution: Creator floor for FIRST-time funders (0 = none). The                        contract enforces max(minContribution, ceil(goal / 256));                        waived only for the contribution that exactly completes the goal.

params.deadline: Unix time at which funding closes (must be in the future).
params.recipient: Payee. Not zero, not this contract, not the token.
params.ref: Title or invoice reference, at most 64 bytes.
params.salt: Caller-chosen salt; the id is keccak256(abi.encode(msg.sender, salt)).
params.shares: Non-zero share per contributor; must sum to `goal`.

returns.refunded: True once the contributor has pulled a refund.
returns.share: Agreed share (Split pots; 0 for Open pots).

SETTLE_GRACE().notice: A fully funded pot still unsettled this long after its deadline is refundable and can no longer be settled.

computePotId(address,bytes32).notice: Derive the id a creator gets for a salt. Ids cannot be squatted:         the creator address is part of the preimage.

createOpenPot(bytes32,address,uint256,ui.notice: Create an Open pot: anyone may fund any amount until the goal is met.

createSplitPot(bytes32,address,uint256,u.notice: Create a Split pot: named contributors with fixed shares summing to `goal`.

effectiveMinContribution(bytes32).notice: Smallest contribution a FIRST-time funder may make to an Open pot:         max(minContribution, ceil(goal / MAX_OPEN_CONTRIBUTORS)). Waived only         for the exact completing payment. Repeat funders may add any amount         above zero. Returns 0 for Split pots (not applicable).

fund(bytes32,uint256).notice: Put `amount` in the kitty. Caller must have approved this contract.         Rejects fee-on-transfer tokens by requiring an exact receipt.

refund(bytes32).notice: After the deadline, pull back exactly your own contribution from a         pot that is not fully funded, or from a fully funded pot that is         still unsettled at deadline + SETTLE_GRACE. Once per contributor.

settle(bytes32).notice: Pay the full goal to the recipient. Permissionless once         totalFunded == goal; callable before or after the deadline but only         until deadline + SETTLE_GRACE; once only.

token().notice: The single ERC-20 accepted by every pot on this deployment.

totalEscrowLiability().notice: Tokens this contract owes: sum of contributions in pots that are neither settled nor refunded. Stray transfers never count toward entitlements.
